name: Taskster Design System
description: Verbindliche Design-Tokens für Taskster. Quelle: app.vue, tailwind.config.ts, pages/*.vue, components/*.vue. Bei Design-Änderungen IMMER diese Datei mitaktualisieren.

meta.wallpaperNote: Alle Flächen liegen über einem wechselnden Hintergrundbild. Deshalb sind Transparenz + backdrop-blur + Liquid-Glass-Klassen Pflicht für Lesbarkeit.

brand.note: Das ist die ECHTE Markenfarbe. NICHT mit tailwind.config.ts 'brand' (grün) verwechseln – das ist ungenutzt.

accent.note: rose-600 / rose-500 – für Löschen, Stoppen, Warnungen

spacing.pageContainer: max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-8

buttons.$comment: VERBINDLICHER STANDARD: px-6 text-xs h-[42px] rounded-lg. Abweichungen nur bei Icon-Buttons oder Tabellen-Aktionen.

primary.definition: @apply bg-[#00A3C4] hover:bg-[#008ba8] text-white font-semibold transition inline-flex items-center justify-center space-x-2 shadow-sm shadow-cyan-900/10 cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed active:scale-[0.99]

accent.definition: @apply bg-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-500 text-white font-semibold transition inline-flex items-center justify-center space-x-2 shadow-sm shadow-rose-900/10 cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed active:scale-[0.99]

light.definition: @apply bg-white hover:bg-slate-50 text-slate-800 border-[3px] border-[#00A3C4] font-semibold transition inline-flex items-center justify-center space-x-2 shadow-sm cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed active:scale-[0.99]

buttons.tableAction: taskster_button_light px-4 text-xs h-[34px] rounded-lg shadow-xs

liquidGlass.$comment: Drei Varianten. Auswahl nach Lesbarkeits-Anforderung: je höher die Deckkraft, desto besser lesbar.

navbar.classes: liquid_glass sticky top-0 z-40 text-slate-900 shadow-md transition-colors border-b border-white/60
navbar.inner: max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 h-16 flex items-center justify-between
navbar.navLink: px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all

sidebar.classes: hidden md:flex flex-col w-16 hover:w-56 bg-white/80 hover:bg-white/95 backdrop-blur-xl border-l border-white/50 shadow-2xl transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out group/sidebar z-30 sticky top-16 h-[calc(100vh-4rem)] select-none shrink-0
sidebar.item: flex items-center space-x-3 px-2.5 py-2.5 rounded-2xl transition text-slate-700 hover:text-[#00A3C4] hover:bg-cyan-50/80
sidebar.label: hidden group-hover/sidebar:inline text-xs font-bold whitespace-nowrap

cards.solidCard: bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-3xl p-6 sm:p-8 shadow-sm
cards.hoverCard: liquid_glass_card hover:border-[#00A3C4] rounded-3xl p-6 shadow-md hover:shadow-xl transition

inputs.text: w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-white/70 border border-white/60 rounded-xl text-xs text-slate-900 focus:bg-white/90 focus:outline-none focus:border-cyan-600 backdrop-blur-sm
inputs.textSolid: w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-slate-50 border border-slate-300 rounded-xl text-xs text-slate-900 focus:bg-white focus:outline-none focus:border-cyan-600
inputs.disabled: w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-white/30 border border-white/40 rounded-xl text-xs text-slate-600 cursor-not-allowed font-medium backdrop-blur-sm
inputs.select: w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-white/70 border border-white/60 rounded-xl text-xs text-slate-900 font-semibold focus:outline-none focus:border-cyan-600
inputs.textarea: w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-white/70 border border-white/60 rounded-xl text-xs text-slate-900 focus:outline-none focus:border-cyan-600 resize-y
inputs.label: block text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 mb-1
inputs.checkbox: w-4 h-4 rounded border-slate-300 text-cyan-600 focus:ring-0 cursor-pointer

tables.thead: bg-white/60 text-slate-600 uppercase font-bold text-[10px] tracking-wider border-b border-slate-200/80

badges.pill: px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider border
badges.chip: px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md text-[10px] font-bold bg-white/90 border border-slate-200 text-slate-700
badges.countBadge: text-[11px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-white/90 text-slate-700 shadow-xs border border-slate-200/60

tabs.bar: liquid_glass_pill rounded-2xl px-4 py-1.5 mb-6 flex items-center space-x-3 overflow-x-auto shadow-sm
tabs.button: py-2 px-3 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition flex items-center space-x-2 cursor-pointer shrink-0
tabs.underlineTab: py-3.5 text-xs border-b-2 transition flex items-center space-x-1.5 whitespace-nowrap cursor-pointer

modals.overlay: fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-slate-900/50 backdrop-blur-sm
modals.overlayStrong: fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-3 sm:p-6 bg-slate-950/60 backdrop-blur-md overflow-y-auto
modals.panel: bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-3xl max-w-md w-full p-6 sm:p-8 shadow-2xl
modals.panelLarge: bg-white rounded-3xl shadow-2xl border border-slate-200 w-full max-w-4xl max-h-[92vh] flex flex-col overflow-hidden
modals.header: flex items-center justify-between pb-4 border-b border-slate-100 mb-6
modals.title: text-lg font-black text-slate-900
modals.subtitle: text-xs text-slate-500 mt-0.5
modals.closeButton: text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-700 text-lg font-bold p-1 rounded-lg
modals.footer: flex items-center justify-end space-x-3 pt-4 border-t border-slate-100

breadcrumb.classes: inline-flex items-center space-x-2 text-xs text-slate-700 font-semibold px-4 py-2 rounded-2xl liquid_glass_pill

feedback.success: mb-6 p-4 rounded-2xl bg-emerald-500/15 border border-emerald-300 text-emerald-950 text-xs font-bold liquid_glass_pill
feedback.error: mb-6 p-4 rounded-2xl bg-rose-500/15 border border-rose-300 text-rose-950 text-xs font-bold liquid_glass_pill

avatars.gradient: w-8 h-8 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-tr from-cyan-600 to-teal-500 text-white flex items-center justify-center text-xs font-black shadow-sm
avatars.stack: inline-block w-5 h-5 rounded-full ring-1 ring-white bg-gradient-to-tr from-cyan-600 to-teal-500 text-white text-[9px] font-black flex items-center justify-center
avatars.initials: w-9 h-9 rounded-full bg-cyan-100 text-cyan-800 font-bold flex items-center justify-center text-xs border border-cyan-200

stopwatch.pill: flex items-center space-x-2.5 px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-2xl bg-slate-900/90 border border-cyan-500/50 text-white shadow-lg backdrop-blur-md
stopwatch.time: font-mono font-black text-xs sm:text-sm tracking-wider text-cyan-300
stopwatch.stopButton: px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg bg-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-500 text-white font-black text-[11px] flex items-center space-x-1 shadow-xs transition transform hover:scale-105 cursor-pointer

emptyState.icon: w-16 h-16 rounded-2xl bg-cyan-50 text-[#00A3C4] flex items-center justify-center text-2xl font-black mx-auto mb-3 shadow-xs
emptyState.title: text-sm font-black text-slate-800
emptyState.text: text-xs text-slate-500 max-w-sm mx-auto mt-1 mb-6

layout.appShell: min-h-screen relative flex flex-col font-sans antialiased text-slate-900 selection:bg-cyan-500 selection:text-white
layout.wallpaperImage: w-full h-full object-cover object-center filter brightness-[0.92] contrast-[1.03] transition-all duration-700 ease-out

wallpapers.note: Nutzer kann Wallpaper wechseln. Design MUSS auf allen 15 Bildern lesbar bleiben.

must: Buttons immer mit Standardgröße px-6 text-xs h-[42px] rounded-lg (außer Icon-/Tabellen-Buttons).
Primärfarbe ist #00A3C4 – niemals eine andere Blau/Cyan-Nuance als Hauptfarbe.
Alle Flächen über dem Wallpaper brauchen Liquid-Glass-Klasse ODER bg-white mit ausreichender Deckkraft.
Überschriften: font-black + tracking-tight. Labels: uppercase + tracking-wider.
Modals: Overlay bg-slate-900/50 backdrop-blur-sm, Panel bg-white rounded-3xl shadow-2xl.
Abbrechen-Button ist IMMER taskster_button_light, Bestätigen IMMER taskster_button.
Deutsche UI-Texte, Schweizer Zahlenformat (de-CH), Währung CHF als Default.
mustNot: Keine neuen Farben erfinden – nur die definierten Paletten nutzen.
Kein bg-white ohne Liquid-Glass auf großen Flächen (Lesbarkeit auf Wallpaper).
Kein font-normal für Überschriften oder Badges.
Keine Inline-Styles für Farben außer bei dynamischen Werten (task.color, section.color).
Kein Dark-Mode-Code (darkMode ist definiert, aber nicht implementiert).
accessibility: Kontrast: Text auf Liquid Glass immer slate-900/slate-700 (nicht slate-400).
Fokus: focus:outline-none focus:border-cyan-600 (Inputs) bzw. focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#00A3C4].
